## Overview

### Learning Goals

- [ ] Review the "4 Horseman" of inference:
  - Monte-Carlo simulation (assumptions)
  - Bootstrap (resampling with replacement)
  - Permutation (shuffling)
  - Cross-validation (generalization)
- [ ] Understand the General Linear Model (GLM)
- [ ] Understand the Ordinary-Least-Squares (OLS) estimator
